categories.main_business_segments: CREEK & RIVER operates in five main business segments: Creative (Japan), Creative (Korea), Medical, Accounting & Legal, and Other businesses. The Creative segment covers video, game, web, advertising, and publishing industries, while the Medical segment focuses on doctor agency services. The Accounting & Legal segment provides agency services for accountants and lawyers, and the Other segment includes IT, fashion, VR/AR, AI, agriculture, and consulting-related businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a network of professional creators and specialists, utilizing advanced project management, content production, and rights management methods. It employs proprietary platforms for matching professionals with client needs, develops original content (including VR, AI, and digital media), and offers training programs to upskill talent. Technology-driven solutions such as AI-powered tools, VR content creation, and digital marketing are central to its service delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include corporations and organizations in the creative industries (media, gaming, advertising, publishing), healthcare institutions, law and accounting firms, IT companies, and public sector entities. The company also serves professionals such as creators, doctors, engineers, lawyers, accountants, architects, and chefs, acting as an intermediary between these professionals and client organizations.
categories.geographic_coverage: CREEK & RIVER has a strong presence in Japan, with additional operations in South Korea, China, the United States, and Canada (Montreal). The majority of revenue is generated in Japan, but the company is expanding its global footprint, particularly in North America and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream service provider, connecting upstream professional talent with downstream client organizations. It acts as an intermediary, producer, and rights manager, facilitating the flow of expertise, content, and intellectual property between creators/professionals and end-users or corporate clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding into new professional domains, developing new services (especially in AI, DX, and XR/VR), and strengthening global and regional networks. The company emphasizes sustainability, diversity, and inclusion, as well as the creation of new business models through professional collaboration. Investment in digital transformation, original content, and professional education are key innovation themes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of agency fees (staffing and placement), project-based production contracts, licensing and rights management, subscription and platform fees, and product sales (including VR/IoT devices). The company also earns from consulting, media, and investment activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CREEK & RIVER is a leading professional agency and content producer in Japan, with a unique multi-domain approach spanning creative, medical, legal, and IT fields. Its main competitors include specialized staffing agencies, content production companies, and consulting firms, but its integrated, cross-industry model and extensive professional network provide a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending February 2025, consolidated revenue reached approximately 50.3 billion yen, with operating profit of 3.6 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 2.25 billion yen. The company has shown steady revenue growth over the past five years, though profit margins have recently declined due to strategic investments and market headwinds. The group employs over 2,500 people and continues to expand through M&A and new business development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CREEK & RIVER differentiates itself through its vast network of over 410,000 professionals, multi-industry expertise, and ability to deliver high-value, customized solutions across creative, medical, legal, and IT sectors. The company emphasizes the enhancement of professional lifetime value, client value creation, and the development of innovative, high-quality services that leverage cross-disciplinary collaboration and advanced technology.
